en.headline: Review overlaps before importing.
en.intro: Compare your existing ledger and incoming CSV. See the evidence behind every new, overlapping or uncertain row.
en.fileLimits: Up to 5 MiB / 20,000 rows each. File contents stay in local memory.
en.settingsHint: Accounts and currencies must correspond. Equal amounts alone never automatically exclude a row.
en.trustIds: I confirm both files use the same transaction ID system. Only unique IDs with matching date, amount, account and currency are treated as existing transactions.
en.reviewGuide: Pending and invalid rows stay out of import files. The bundle includes selected CSVs, a review queue and a full audit.
en.auditHint: Only the provided history is compared. Missing exports, split transactions and currency conversions are not covered. Up to five candidates are shown per row; the full count is preserved. A matching payee alone does not establish identity.
en.footerScope: ImportGuard 0.3 · Import assistance, without ledger updates. Keep original CSVs and ledger backups; preview a small batch in the destination first.
en.footerPrivacy: No bank connection, external model or analytics. Reloading loses files and decisions. Only your language preference is saved in this browser.
en.existingHint: Exported ledger history to check for overlapping transactions.
en.incomingHint: Bank or other source transactions you want to add to the ledger.
en.signedAmount: Signed amount: negative expense, positive income
en.defaultAccount: Account to use when no column is mapped
en.defaultCurrency: Currency to use when no column is mapped
en.invertAmount: Invert signs (only if positive means expense in the source)
en.confirmHint: Confirm columns, date format, amount direction and account names.
en.chooseHint: Choose both files and confirm their column mappings.
en.cleared: Session cleared. Uploaded files were not saved.
en.settingsChanged: Settings changed. Previous results and decisions were cleared; run the check again.
en.requestFailed: The local service could not complete the request. Check that ImportGuard is running, then try again.
en.fileTooLarge: Each file can be at most 5 MiB. Split the export into batches.
en.fileReadFailed: Unable to read the file. Select it again.
en.multipleGroups: {n} account/currency groups selected. Files will be exported separately.
en.multipleGroupsHint: Use import-manifest.json to find each file in accounts/ and import it into its matching account. Combined summaries are for review only.
en.singleGroup: One account/currency group selected. Import files remain at the ZIP root.
en.resultDescription: Existing: {existing} · Incoming: {incoming}. Results cover only these two files.
en.fixAndRerun: Correct the source file, then check again
en.checkComplete: Check complete. Needs review: {review}. Invalid rows: {invalid}. Review these first.
en.demoFailed: Unable to load the sample statements.
en.demoLoaded: Synthetic samples loaded: overlaps, distinct purchases, account/currency differences, an invalid date and formula-like text. Sample IDs share one system, so ID confirmation is selected. Reconfirm it for real files.
en.exportReady: Review bundle ready. Read README.txt and import-manifest.json, then select the matching account/currency files. Pending and invalid rows are excluded.

zh-CN.headline: 先看清重叠，再导入账单。
zh-CN.intro: 把已有账本和待导入 CSV 放在一起检查。每一笔新增、重叠和疑问都有依据。
zh-CN.fileLimits: 每份最多 5 MiB / 20,000 行；文件只在本机内存中处理
zh-CN.settingsHint: 账户名和币种必须能对应；默认只提示候选，不凭金额相同自动排除。
zh-CN.trustIds: 我确认两份文件的交易 ID 来自同一标识体系。只有唯一 ID 与日期、金额、账户和币种一致时，自动判为已有。
zh-CN.reviewGuide: 待定和无效行不会进入新增文件。下载包含新增 CSV、复核清单及全部行的审计记录。
zh-CN.tableLabel: 逐行检查结果，可横向滚动
zh-CN.auditHint: 只比较你提供的历史范围；无法发现未导出的历史、拆分交易或跨币种换算。候选最多显示 5 条，完整候选数量另列。姓名相同也不能证明同一笔交易。
zh-CN.footerScope: ImportGuard 0.3 · 导入辅助工具，不回写账本。请保留原 CSV 与账本备份，并在目标应用中先小批预览。
zh-CN.footerPrivacy: 不接银行、不使用外部模型、无统计追踪。刷新会失去文件与决定；仅在本浏览器记住语言偏好。
zh-CN.existingHint: 从当前账本导出的记录，用来检查历史重叠。
zh-CN.incomingHint: 需要补入账本的银行或其他来源账单。
zh-CN.fileOptions: 文件编码与分隔符（读不出时调整）
zh-CN.mappingTitle: 确认对应字段（* 必填）
zh-CN.signedAmount: 单列金额：负数支出，正数收入
zh-CN.splitAmount: 支出 / 收入分别两列
zh-CN.invertAmount: 反转金额正负号（仅当源文件正数表示支出）
zh-CN.preview: 查看前 4 行原始内容
zh-CN.confirmHint: 请确认字段、日期格式、金额方向以及账户名。
zh-CN.chooseHint: 请先选择两份文件并确认字段映射。
zh-CN.cleared: 已清空会话；本工具没有保存上传文件。
zh-CN.settingsChanged: 设置已变化，原检查与人工选择已清除，请重新检查。
zh-CN.requestFailed: 本机服务未能完成请求。请确认 ImportGuard 仍在运行，再重试。
zh-CN.fileTooLarge: 单个文件最多 5 MiB，请分批导出。
zh-CN.fileReadFailed: 读取失败，请重新选择文件。
zh-CN.decisionCounts: 将加入 {include} 笔　排除 {exclude} 笔　待定 {pending} 笔
zh-CN.multipleGroups: 本次新增涉及 {n} 个账户/币种组合，将分文件导出。
zh-CN.multipleGroupsHint: 下载后按 import-manifest.json 找到 accounts/ 下的对应文件，逐个导入相同目标账户。汇总文件只供复核，不能直接导入单个账户。
zh-CN.singleGroup: 本次只有一个账户/币种组合，保留根目录新增文件。
zh-CN.noGroup: 当前没有选择新增记录。
zh-CN.resultDescription: 已有 {existing} 笔，待导入 {incoming} 笔。结果只覆盖这两份文件。
zh-CN.candidatesLimited: 查看 {n} 笔历史候选（显示前5笔）
zh-CN.emptyResults: 没有符合当前筛选的记录。
zh-CN.checkComplete: 检查完成。请优先核对 {review} 笔疑问和 {invalid} 笔格式错误。
zh-CN.demoLoaded: 已载入模拟数据，含重叠、真实多笔、不同账户/币种、错误日期及公式样式文本。模拟两份ID属于同一体系，已勾选确认；使用真实文件时需重新确认。
zh-CN.exportReady: 已准备复核包下载。请先看 README.txt 与 import-manifest.json，按账户/币种选择文件；待定和无效行未进入新增。
